description: The bar chart illustrates the average performance of various models on November 2024 AMC 10/12 tests. The horizontal axis lists the model names, including Llama 3.3 70B-instruct, Claude 3.5 Sonnet, Qwen 2.5 14b-instruct, GPT 4o, GPT 4o-mini, Owen 2.5 72b-instruct, Gemini Flash 1.5, Gemini Pro 1.5, and phi-4, while the vertical axis represents the average score, ranging from 60 to 90 with a linear scale and tick labels at intervals of 10. Each model is represented by a pair of bars, with light blue bars corresponding to the main model and dark blue bars representing the small model, as indicated by the legend. The average scores for the main models range from approximately 66.4 for Llama 3.3 70B-instruct to 89.8 for Gemini Pro 1.5, with the dark blue bars generally being slightly higher or similar in value, except for Llama 3.3 70B-instruct, which only has a light blue bar. The models are listed in a specific order, not sorted alphabetically or by value, and there is no visual emphasis on any particular bar. The chart provides a clear visual representation of the relative performance of each model, with phi-4 achieving the highest average score of 91.8.
